entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #39560
  • SQLite: AddMonths and AddYears overflow into the next month instead of using the last day of the month #39545
    12.0-preview1

Closed

  • Query precompiler rejects an integer zero implicitly converted to decimal in a projection #39303
    12.0-preview1
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetTextReader and GetChars return garbage for TEXT values in a UTF-16 database #39546
    12.0-preview1
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetSchemaTable throws or returns wrong metadata when another database has a table with the same name #39549

PullRequests

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #39559

    community-contribution
  • Materialize a right/full-joined outer non-entity projection as null on no-match (#30915) #39556
    community-contribution
  • Make non-shared query test store names unique per test class #39551
    community-contribution
  • Use the last day of the month for AddMonths and AddYears on SQLite #39548
    community-contribution
